description: Review caller-supplied camera/recorder offset estimates for independent-method agreement, confidence and conflicting alternatives. All matches require selection; conflicting matches cannot be approved. Does not analyze audio, calibrate confidence or synchronize Premiere.

agreement_tolerance_seconds.description: Maximum spread between methods for agreement; defaults to 0.04 seconds.

expected_review_revision.description: Revision from the initial review; required when selecting or rejecting entries. A changed input requires a new review.

matches.description: Camera-recorder proposals from already captured local analysis.

estimates.description: One estimate per independent method; conflicting evidence remains blocked.

confidence.description: Caller-supplied confidence, not a calibrated tool probability.

method.description: Independent evidence method supplied by the caller; not run by this tool.

offset_seconds.description: Recorder source time equals camera source time plus this offset.

minimum_confidence.description: Required confidence on every estimate to label strong agreement; all matches still need approval.

rejected_ids.description: Explicitly rejected entry IDs. Unselected entries remain pending.

selected_ids.description: Explicitly approved entry IDs. Omit for an initial review; an empty array approves nothing.

name: review_sync_evidence

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Review Sync Evidence
